item.title: BCSD names interim superintendent to permanent job
item.description: The Bakersfield City School District has a new superintendent after its board voted this week to install the man it appointed to the job on an interim basis in July.

item.title: Peters calls Kern 'open for business' in State of the County address
item.description: Not only are industries in Kern County on the up-and-up, they’re poised to lead a transformation of California and the nation.

item.title: Fourth suit challenges oil setbacks law
item.description: A conservative group representing Santa Barbara County royalty owners filed a lawsuit this week challenging California’s contentious oil-field setbacks law, taking the fourth such legal action and the second in federal court.

item.title: Community Voices: This is exactly what you voted for
item.description: Now that year one of Trump’s second term has just ended, and his poll numbers have sunken to a well-deserved all-time low, disillusioned Trump voters all over America are lamenting that “they didn’t vote for this!”
